data.one_liner: A Dart client for the Genius.com API to fetch song, artist, and lyrics data.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple interface to query Genius.com for artists, songs, albums, and their corresponding lyrics. It allows developers to search data and save lyrics to local files.
use_when: You need to fetch song lyrics or artist data from Genius.com in your Dart or Flutter app.
You want to search for albums and tracks using the Genius API.
avoid_when: You are streaming music or handling actual audio/video playback.
You need a backend client for services other than Genius.com.
strengths: Simple interface inspired by the LyricsGenixir Python library.
Supports searching by artist, song title, and album with options to include featured tracks.
weaknesses: Requires a free Genius API access token to function.
Tied exclusively to the Genius.com platform.
data.setup_notes: Sign up for a free Genius account to obtain an access token for the Genius API.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer making raw HTTP requests to the Genius API directly without using a wrapper package.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a robust HTTP client with advanced features like interceptors for calling the Genius API.
